summary: Iteration 54 — Full end-to-end QA over Deployment Center Alert Channels (4 channels + modes, per-channel Test, delivery log, auto-retry backoff, routing). Backend pytest 9/9 PASSED (test_iter54_channels_full.py; ran with -o addopts='' to serialize since parallel workers race on the shared alert_channels doc): (1) PUT/GET /api/admin/deploy/alert-channels persists all 4 URLs + all 4 modes. (2) POST /alert-channels/test-one returns 200 with {ok:true,status:200} for httpbin.org/post, {ok:false,status:418} for /status/418, 400 for empty URL, 502 for an unreachable host. (3) GET /alert-channels/deliveries groups rows per channel with attempts/status/ok/at fields. (4) Auto-retry: with webhook=https://httpbin.org/status/500 & mode=all, POST /alert-channels/test blocks ~4s (1s+3s backoff) and records the webhook delivery with attempts=3, ok=false. A success run (httpbin.org/post) records attempts=1. (5) Routing: discord=maintenance rejects incident.opened; whatsapp=outages rejects degraded incidents (only webhook fires). Frontend Playwright: logged in as admin, opened Admin → Deployment → Channels (channels-toggle-btn) → alert-channels-panel renders 4 rows (slack/discord/whatsapp + generic webhook), each with input + mode select + Test button. Verified toasts: empty URL → 'Enter a URL for this channel first'; https://httpbin.org/post → 'Test delivered (HTTP 200)'; https://httpbin.org/status/418 → 'Endpoint responded HTTP 418'. delivery-log renders below with delivery-row-slack / delivery-row-discord / delivery-row-webhook chips (green 200, red 418/500) + time-ago labels; delivery-refresh-btn reloads it. Configuring webhook to https://httpbin.org/status/500 + mode=all, saving, then clicking test-channels-btn produced a delivery-row-webhook chip labelled '500 ↻3 · 1s' — retries visible in the UI. Re-saving with https://httpbin.org/post and re-testing produced a fresh '200 · 3s' chip with NO ↻ marker (attempts=1). Cleanup: all 4 channel URLs cleared, all 4 modes reset to 'all', save persisted (verified via post-run GET); routing TEST_iter54 incident resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: test-one endpoint records delivery on network exception with status=0 but STILL raises HTTPException(502) — fine; however the delivery log's err chip color hinges on ok=false which is correct. No action, just noting.
webhook_deliveries collection is trimmed to last 15 per channel in _record_delivery; consider adding an index on {channel:1, at:-1} if this grows across many channels/events.
seed_data_creation: Transient: 1 TEST_iter54 status incident (degraded, then resolved). Alert channel URLs set to httpbin URLs during testing then cleared. Final DB state: all 4 alert_channels URLs empty, all 4 modes 'all'. webhook_deliveries collection has recent TEST entries but the collection is self-trimming to last 15 per channel so no manual cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: The generic-webhook input testid is 'webhook-url-input' (NOT 'webhook-url-webhook-input' as iter53 report claimed). Confirmed by grepping DeploymentTab.jsx line 450 inputId='webhook-url-input'. The mode select is 'webhook-url-mode-select'. The retry marker in the delivery chip renders as '↻3' (unicode arrow + digit) — searching for '↻' works. When testing retry-backoff via pytest, RUN THE FILE WITH -o addopts='' TO DISABLE xdist parallelism — otherwise concurrent workers PUT-clear alert_channels while another worker awaits _dispatch_alerts and the retries never fire, giving a false negative on elapsed time and attempts. The POST /admin/deploy/alert-channels/test-one endpoint's empty-URL 400 only fires if the STORED channel URL is also empty (it falls back to reading db.settings for the channel key); clear channels first if you want to force the 400.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all 5 requested feature areas (channels save + persistence, per-channel Test button with 3 toast variants, delivery log w/ chips + refresh, auto-retry with backoff producing attempts=3/↻3 marker, per-channel routing) verified working end-to-end via API + UI.
